review.shorterRoute: The generic finite-coordinate theorem already supplies finite canonical support. Its canonical divisor space and the already proved cover divisor-space finiteness yield a finite regular-differential basis without numerical genus or Riemann-Roch reconstruction. Native evaluation separation and inverse-function image arguments then establish Jacobi inversion. The vanishing-germ lemma and full real period-span argument are unnecessary here and are omitted.
review.remaining: Cover Abel converse, actual point division and arithmetic descent remain unproved. Original pairing nondegeneracy, Hecke-component restriction and determinant, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain open. DUB-17--20 OPEN;16/20.

discharged: The actual regular differential space of the literal complex Kummer cover is finite dimensional and has a constructed basis. Its center evaluations separate and span; a proved evaluation frame and the native inverse function theorem make the actual degree-zero Abel image open. Connected complex coordinate space makes that image the whole space. Every coordinate vector is therefore represented by an actual degree-zero cover divisor modulo actual loop periods. No finite-dimensionality, basis, frame, local-surjectivity or Jacobi-inversion hypothesis remains. The principal-divisor converse is still required for auxiliary point division.
